content.value: An ideal Diesel engine operates on 0.5 kg of air with a suction state of 0.1 MPa and $3 5 \ \textdegree C .$ The pressure at the end of compression is 35 bar and the cut off is at 6.3% of the stroke from the head end dead centre position. Using air properties, determine -(i) the compression ratio, (ii) the percentage clearance, (iii) the heat supplied, (iv) the thermal efficiency, and (v) the mep.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
